_why: The duplicate-skill advisory exists because a codex home held a stale `h-mad` beside the linked checkout and the install check read PASS (2026-11-22). Every mutation here makes the advisory quiet or falsely reassuring in one spelling: could-not-check read as none, a pin that is not a disable silencing it, one home standing in for all, or the lines never reaching main().

mutations.name: skill-dup-missing-verifier-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-VERIFIER. Return no lines when the verifier cannot be loaded and a check that never ran reads as a clean home.
mutations.find:
except ValueError as exc:  # M:SD-VERIFIER
        return [f"CODEX_SKILL_DUPLICATE_UNKNOWN:{DUPLICATE_VERIFIER} reason={exc}"]
mutations.replace:
except ValueError as exc:  # M:SD-VERIFIER
        return []

mutations.name: skill-dup-one-home-reports-once
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-ONCE. Drop the seen guard and a home reached by two spellings (CODEX_HOME and its symlink) prints every duplicate twice.

mutations.name: skill-dup-shared-skills-dir-keeps-each-config
mutations._mechanism: Key the seen guard on the skills dir alone and a second home sharing that dir is skipped, so the first home's pin silences a copy the second home's config leaves on.

mutations.name: skill-dup-same-file-is-not-a-duplicate
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-SAME-FILE. Drop the real-path comparison and two links to one checkout skill, which cannot drift or shadow, raise an advisory on every correct install.
mutations.find: if others and os.path.realpath(copy) not in other_reals]  # M:SD-SAME-FILE

mutations.name: skill-dup-keeps-every-copy-of-a-name
mutations._mechanism: Keep only the first SKILL.md per name and a correct link, walked first, hides the stale copy beside it.

mutations.name: skill-dup-unreadable-config-is-reported
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-CONFIG-UNKNOWN. Swallow the config error silently and the operator is never told the pins could not be read.

mutations.name: skill-dup-unreadable-config-never-suppresses
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-CONFIG-UNKNOWN. Skip the home when its config cannot be read and could-not-check hides a duplicate that was seen.
mutations.find:
lines.append(f"CODEX_SKILL_DUPLICATE_UNKNOWN:{config} reason={exc}")
        for name, codex_copy, others in pairs:

mutations.name: skill-dup-disabled-codex-copy-is-silent
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-DISABLED. Ignore the pin on the codex-home copy and the documented remedy leaves a permanent advisory, which teaches the reader to ignore the line.

mutations.name: skill-dup-disabled-agents-copy-is-shadowed
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-SHADOWED. Report a disabled agents copy as an ordinary duplicate and the line tells the operator codex lists both, when it uses only the stale one.

mutations.name: skill-dup-only-enabled-false-disables
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-DISABLED-ONLY. Treat any `[[skills.config]]` entry as a disable and an explicit `enabled = true` silences the duplicate it keeps live.
mutations.find: if not isinstance(path, str) or entry.get("enabled") is not False:  # M:SD-DISABLED-ONLY

mutations.name: skill-dup-relative-pin-is-ignored
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-ABSOLUTE-PIN. Resolve a relative pin and whether it silences the line depends on the directory the check was run from.

mutations.name: skill-dup-odd-config-shape-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-CONFIG-SHAPE. Read a config whose `skills` is not a table as holding no pins and could-not-read becomes an answer.
mutations.replace: entries = [e for e in (entries or []) if isinstance(e, dict)]  # M:SD-CONFIG-SHAPE

mutations.name: skill-dup-unlistable-root-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-UNREADABLE. Drop the unreadable lines and a skills dir that could not be listed reads as a home with no duplicates.
mutations.find: lines += [_unknown_line(item) for item in dict.fromkeys(unreadable)]  # M:SD-UNREADABLE

mutations.name: skill-dup-unexaminable-home-is-not-absent
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-STAT. Read EACCES as absent and a codex home that could not be entered reports no duplicates, which is what python 3.14+ `is_dir()` did.
mutations.find:
except OSError as exc:  # M:SD-STAT
        return f"unreadable:{type(exc).__name__}"
mutations.replace:
except OSError as exc:  # M:SD-STAT
        return "absent"

mutations.name: skill-dup-unexaminable-agents-root-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: Return no lines for an agents root that could not be examined and the whole check reads as clean.

mutations.name: skill-dup-unnamed-file-is-not-compared
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-NAMED. Fall back to the folder name and a SKILL.md codex may never list is reported as a duplicate.
mutations.replace:
name = verifier.skill_name(text) or path.parent.name
        if name:  # M:SD-NAMED

mutations.name: skill-dup-compares-the-frontmatter-name
mutations._mechanism: Compare folder names and a stale copy saved under another folder name, which codex still lists as `h-mad`, is invisible.

mutations.name: skill-dup-empty-override-means-no-homes
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-HOMES-ENV. Read an empty override as unset and a test or operator that names no homes gets the developer's real ones.
mutations.find: if CODEX_HOMES_ENV not in env:  # M:SD-HOMES-ENV

mutations.name: skill-dup-reaches-main
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-MAIN-WIRE. Never call the check from main() and the advisory exists only for callers of the function, which there are none of.
mutations.find: for line in codex_skill_duplicate_lines(codex_homes, agents_dir):  # M:SD-MAIN-WIRE

mutations.name: skill-dup-cannot-crash-after-the-verdict
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-NO-CRASH. Narrow the catch and an unexpected error prints a traceback after `INSTALL:` and turns exit 0 into exit 1.

mutations.name: skill-dup-checks-every-home
mutations._mechanism: Stop after the first home and the 2026-11-22 layout, one duplicate in the Orca home and one in `~/.codex`, reports half.
mutations.find:
for home in homes:
        skills_root = home / "skills"
mutations.replace:
for home in homes[:1]:
        skills_root = home / "skills"

mutations.name: skill-dup-pins-are-per-home
mutations._mechanism: Read the pins from another home's config and a disable written there silences a duplicate here.
mutations.find:
config = home / "config.toml"
        # Keyed on the skills dir AND the config
mutations.replace:
config = homes[-1] / "config.toml"
        # Keyed on the skills dir AND the config

mutations.name: skill-dup-discovery-covers-both-homes
mutations._mechanism: Discover only `$CODEX_HOME` and a duplicate in `~/.codex` is never seen from an Orca session.

mutations.name: skill-dup-discovery-covers-codex-home
mutations._mechanism: Discover `~/.codex` and the Orca accounts but not `$CODEX_HOME`, and a codex pointed at a home elsewhere is never checked.

mutations.name: skill-dup-discovery-covers-orca-accounts
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-ACCOUNTS. Drop the Orca account homes and the home where the 2026-11-22 stale `h-mad` sat is checked only when the session happens to export it as CODEX_HOME.
mutations.find: return found + [accounts / name / "home" for name in names]  # M:SD-ACCOUNTS

mutations.name: skill-dup-unlistable-accounts-dir-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-ACCOUNTS-UNKNOWN. Read an accounts dir that could not be listed as holding no accounts and every Orca home drops out without a line.

mutations.name: skill-dup-line-spells-the-copy-through-its-own-home
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-OWN-SPELLING. Print the cached path and the second of two homes sharing a skills dir is told to pin the first home's spelling, which codex under that home may not match.
mutations.find: mine = {name: [skills_root / path.relative_to(base) for path in paths]  # M:SD-OWN-SPELLING
mutations.replace: mine = {name: [path for path in paths]  # M:SD-OWN-SPELLING

mutations.name: skill-dup-line-names-a-live-agents-copy
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-LIVE-AGENTS. Name the first agents copy regardless of pins and the line points at a copy the config has already turned off.

mutations.name: skill-dup-empty-flag-value-is-reported
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-EMPTY-HOME. Drop the empty-value line and a wrapper passing an unset variable as `--codex-home` checks no home while printing nothing, which reads as no duplicates.
mutations.find: if args.codex_home and not all(args.codex_home):  # M:SD-EMPTY-HOME

mutations.name: skill-dup-crash-line-blames-no-path
mutations._mechanism: Name the agents root in the crash line and a failure in one codex home sends the reader to a directory that is fine.

mutations.name: skill-dup-empty-flag-value-is-never-read
mutations._mechanism: Keep the empty value in the list and `Path("")` makes the cwd a codex home: `<cwd>/skills` is reported.
mutations.find: codex_homes = [Path(p) for p in args.codex_home if p] if args.codex_home \
mutations.replace: codex_homes = [Path(p) for p in args.codex_home] if args.codex_home \

mutations.name: skill-dup-homes-are-printed-absolute
mutations._mechanism: M:SD-ABSOLUTE-HOME. Keep a relative home as given and the printed path names a different tree from every other cwd.
mutations.find: homes = [Path(os.path.abspath(home)) for home in homes]  # M:SD-ABSOLUTE-HOME
